1.original_instruction: Talk to Berbayeff (moscovia 171, 71), who tells you a story about his discovery of the Moving Island.
1.full_ru: Поговорите с Berbayeff (moscovia 171, 71). Он расскажет, как открыл Moving Island.
1.full_en: Talk to Berbayeff (moscovia 171, 71), who tells you a story about his discovery of the Moving Island.

2.original_instruction: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135, 49) and listen to his stories. Then, choose the option "Lend me your ship". He will ask for some items to fix up his ship.
2.short_ru: У Mr. Ibanoff в moscovia 135, 49 выберите «Lend me your ship».
2.short_en: At Mr. Ibanoff in moscovia 135, 49, choose “Lend me your ship”.
2.full_ru: Поговорите с Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135, 49), выслушайте его истории и выберите «Lend me your ship». Он попросит предметы для ремонта корабля.
2.full_en: Talk to Mr. Ibanoff (moscovia 135, 49) and listen to his stories. Then, choose the option "Lend me your ship". He will ask for some items to fix up his ship.

3.original_instruction: Gather the items for Mr. Ibanoff to complete maintenance of the ship. | 10 Rusty Screws | 10 Strange Steel Pieces | 10 Jubilees | 5 Flexible Tubes | Note: The island can only be accessed during the following times: | 12 AM - 3 AM PST | 6 AM - 9 AM PST | 12 PM - 3 PM PST | 6 PM - 9 PM PST
3.short_ru: Передайте Mr. Ibanoff 10 Rusty Screws, 10 Strange Steel Pieces, 10 Jubilees и 5 Flexible Tubes; учитывайте окна PST.
3.short_en: Give Mr. Ibanoff 10 Rusty Screws, 10 Strange Steel Pieces, 10 Jubilees and 5 Flexible Tubes; observe the PST windows.
3.full_ru: Соберите предметы для ремонта корабля Mr. Ibanoff: 10 Rusty Screws, 10 Strange Steel Pieces, 10 Jubilees, 5 Flexible Tubes. Примечание: попасть на остров можно в следующие интервалы: 12 AM - 3 AM PST; 6 AM - 9 AM PST; 12 PM - 3 PM PST; 6 PM - 9 PM PST.
3.full_en: Gather the items for Mr. Ibanoff to complete maintenance of the ship. | 10 Rusty Screws | 10 Strange Steel Pieces | 10 Jubilees | 5 Flexible Tubes | Note: The island can only be accessed during the following times: | 12 AM - 3 AM PST | 6 AM - 9 AM PST | 12 PM - 3 PM PST | 6 PM - 9 PM PST

4.original_instruction: Control the steering wheel of the ship depending on Mr. Ibanoff commands. To get the next command talk to Ibanoff repeatedly. Once he gives a command click on the rudder and choose the direction Ibanoff last gave. Monsters might appear and you will have to kill them all to keep the ship running. | Monsters that might spawn include (Level ??) Obeaune and Raggler (Level ??) Marse and Hydra (Level 70) Kapha and Merman (Level 99) Kapha and Swordfish | The ship cannot be controlled while monsters are present. | Monsters will disappear on their own after 5 minutes, but this part of the quest cannot be cleared if the player doesn't kill them manually. | There is no death penalty if you die on the ship. | Monsters do not give Experience or drop items.
4.short_ru: Следуйте последней команде Ibanoff и убивайте всех появившихся монстров; ожидание исчезновения не завершает этап.
4.short_en: Follow Ibanoff's latest command and kill all spawned monsters; waiting for despawn does not complete the stage.
4.full_ru: Управляйте корабельным штурвалом по командам Mr. Ibanoff. Чтобы получить следующую команду, говорите с Ibanoff снова. После команды нажмите на руль и выберите последнее указанное Ibanoff направление. Могут появляться монстры: для продолжения плавания убейте всех появившихся. Возможные сочетания: (Level ??) Obeaune и Raggler; (Level ??) Marse и Hydra; (Level 70) Kapha и Merman; (Level 99) Kapha и Swordfish. Пока есть монстры, кораблём нельзя управлять. Через 5 минут они исчезнут сами, но без убийства игроком этот этап не завершится. За смерть на корабле нет штрафа; монстры не дают Experience и не оставляют предметов.

13.original_instruction: Speak with the Aged Stranger again to choose whether or not to learn how to play the Gusli from him. It is recommended that you do learn to play from him. You will need to speak with him several (random) times until he tells you that you've become a master at the instrument.
13.short_ru: При желании учитесь играть на Gusli у Aged Stranger до сообщения о мастерстве.
13.short_en: Optionally learn Gusli from Aged Stranger until he announces mastery.
13.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Aged Stranger и решите, будете ли учиться играть на Gusli. Источник рекомендует учиться. Говорите с ним несколько раз — число попыток случайное, — пока он не назовёт вас мастером инструмента.
13.full_en: Speak with the Aged Stranger again to choose whether or not to learn how to play the Gusli from him. It is recommended that you do learn to play from him. You will need to speak with him several (random) times until he tells you that you've become a master at the instrument.

actions.condition: Random/unspecified number of talks; not exactly three.

14.original_instruction: Return to the palace and talk to Csar Aleksay. You have 3 options to choose from: | Play the Gusli after having learned it - Receive 1,200,000 Base EXP and 1 Old Purple Box | Don't play the Gusli - Receive 700,000 Base EXP and 1 Old Blue Box | Play the Gusli without having learned it - Receive 500,000 Base EXP and 1 Old Blue Box (If you pick this path, you will offend the Czar with your bad playing and your reward will be diminished)
14.short_ru: Выберите выступление у Csar Aleksay: обучение Gusli влияет на итоговую награду.
14.short_en: Choose the performance at Csar Aleksay; learning Gusli affects the final reward.
14.full_ru: Вернитесь во дворец к Csar Aleksay. Доступны 3 варианта: сыграть на Gusli после обучения — 1,200,000 Base EXP и 1 Old Purple Box; не играть на Gusli — 700,000 Base EXP и 1 Old Blue Box; сыграть на Gusli без обучения — 500,000 Base EXP и 1 Old Blue Box. В последнем случае плохая игра оскорбит Czar, и награда уменьшится.
14.full_en: Return to the palace and talk to Csar Aleksay. 15.original_instruction: You can now go to Whale Island any time by talking to Mr. Ibanoff with the Gusli equipped in the accessory slot. Talk with the Aged Stranger on the island to be sent to the Moscovia Forest Dungeon . | Note: In order to get Mr. Ibanoff to take you to the island again during an available time period once you've completed the quest, you must walk to the end of the dock next to him! A dialogue box will pop up, asking if you wish to go to the island.
15.short_ru: Экипируйте Gusli, подойдите к концу пристани у Mr. Ibanoff и через Aged Stranger отправляйтесь в Moscovia Forest Dungeon.
15.short_en: Equip Gusli, approach the dock end by Mr. Ibanoff and go through Aged Stranger to Moscovia Forest Dungeon.
15.full_ru: Теперь можно попасть на Whale Island в любое время: поговорите с Mr. Ibanoff, экипировав Gusli в слот аксессуара. На острове поговорите с Aged Stranger, чтобы отправиться в Moscovia Forest Dungeon. Примечание: после завершения квеста для повторной поездки в доступный временной интервал нужно дойти до конца пристани рядом с Mr. Ibanoff. Появится окно с вопросом о поездке на остров.
15.full_en: You can now go to Whale Island any time by talking to Mr. Ibanoff with the Gusli equipped in the accessory slot. Talk with the Aged Stranger on the island to be sent to the Moscovia Forest Dungeon . | Note: In order to get Mr. Ibanoff to take you to the island again during an available time period once you've completed the quest, you must walk to the end of the dock next to him! A dialogue box will pop up, asking if you wish to go to the island.

reviews.detail: Directions follow the latest live command. Actual spawns must be killed; five-minute despawn does not clear the stage. Possible species/level labels are not fixed kill quotas or proven level gates. No ship EXP/drop rewards or death penalty are invented.

Initial repair and later Gusli crafting are separate single sets. Second voyage does not add another repair set. First Stranger visit has three talks; optional learning has a random/unknown count. One Gusli is crafted and retained/equipped for later travel.
Choose one final performance branch; header is not another payout. Learned play, no play and unlearned play have different EXP/box outcomes.

Stage 15 says any time but its note still mentions an available period; stage 3 prints four PST windows. Preserve the conflict, dock trigger and literal PST label without inventing postquest unlimited hours or UTC/DST conversion.
